description: This file defines the TimePurgePredicate class, which determines whether data should be purged from cache based on time-related criteria. It includes logic to compare the time data has been in cache and its relative age to decide if it should be removed.

classes.name: TimePurgePredicate
classes.description: A class that encapsulates logic to decide if cached data should be purged based on time thresholds.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the minimum time in cache and maximum relative message age thresholds.

methods.name: ShouldPurgeFromTime
methods.description: Determines whether a message should be purged based on its time in cache and relative age.
